name: x402 Payment with Fresh Agent Testnet Wallet
query: Create a fresh Radius Testnet wallet, fund it, then pay this x402 endpoint as an automated agent demo.
context: The workflow must avoid interactive Foundry keystores and raw key arguments. radius-cli 0.2.0+ uses radius-sdk for x402 and supports sponsored Permit2 approval.
expected_behavior: Creates or selects the wallet with radius-cli using RADIUS_HOME=.radius and RADIUS_NETWORK=testnet
Reports only the wallet address and other non-secret values
Funds and verifies the wallet using the dripping-faucet skill
Uses radius-cli wallet x402 with an explicit Testnet URL, --x402-threshold, --json, and -y
Treats the threshold as a display-unit hard cap for one request
Explains that the Radius facilitator sponsors the one-time Permit2 approval when advertised
Captures the payment result without exposing keystore material
success_criteria: Every wallet, faucet, RPC, and payment step remains on Testnet
No raw private key appears in output or shell arguments
The wallet is funded and its balance is verified before payment
The paid request refuses an offer above the threshold
The result includes enough receipt or transaction information to reconcile the payment
